paragraphs.text: Trenzalore is a non-canon plane subtype featured in Doctor Who , on the card The Doctor's Tomb .

Trenzalore was a human colony planet, where the village of Christmas was located. Christmas contained the last remaining crack in space-time, through which the Time Lords broadcast the Question and triggered the Siege of Trenzalore . In one timeline, the Siege ended with the death of the Eleventh Doctor and the transformation of his TARDIS into his tomb.
